title: Auto accession cubes
features:
Aggressive Network Ownership: Uses a high-frequency "touch-interest" loop to snatch object control from other players and the server.

Smart Auto-Merge: Instantly scans for identical pairs (e.g., Cube2 + Cube2) within your radius and snaps them together.

Turbo Speed: Optimized to process multiple merges per second without crashing the game engine or triggering lag.

Anti-Fling & Noclip: Temporarily disables cube collisions during transport to prevent them from getting stuck or launching you into the sky.

Built-in Anti-AFK: Prevents you from being kicked for inactivity while the script does the work.
